verdict.rationale: Stale-flag detection and code-reference tracking are a fair axis for a feature-flag platform, but nothing in the evidence pack addresses them. The pack contains no mention of stale or potentially-stale flag marking, flag lifecycle or cleanup reminders, or scanning the codebase for flag references. The Admin API and MCP server items describe only general flag creation and management, not finding or removing stale flags, so they cannot be credited here.
